content.text: You’ve just finished writing your ebook. It’s polished, packaged, and ready to sell. But here’s the problem: Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in Kenya. You can’t collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-broken-here-infrastructure-3|Payment Gateways]]s, and even if you could, delivering the ebook automatically after payment is a technical nightmare. This isn’t just a payment problem—it’s an infrastructure problem. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this. It’s not a workaround; it’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-11|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-10|architecture]]. You own it. You control it. No platform locks you out. This post explains how to deploy automated ebook delivery after crypto payment verification—no Stripe required. By the end, you’ll understand the components, the architecture, and the exact steps to deploy today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete stack that lets you sell digital products without relying on third-party platforms. It’s built for creators in regions where conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted. The core function here is automated delivery: the moment a buyer sends crypto payment, the system verifies it on-chain and delivers the ebook instantly. No manual intervention. No waiting. The buyer gets the product, and you get paid—directly, without intermediaries. This matters because it gives you infrastructure sovereignty. You’re not renting tools; you’re owning the stack. No platform can shut you down, freeze your account, or take a cut of your revenue. It’s your store, your rules, your profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and composed of free or low-cost tools. Here’s how it works: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. Zero hosting fees. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles order processing and file delivery. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets logs transactions. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your ebook files. 5. **Payment Verification**: NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain and triggers delivery via webhook. The buyer pays in crypto (e.g., USDT on BSC for low fees). NOWPayments converts the payment to USD at transaction time and verifies it. Once confirmed, a webhook fires, and the backend logic sends the ebook download link to the buyer’s email or redirects them to a download page. The entire process is automatic and takes seconds.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, or similar markets, this stack is for you. It’s also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty. You don’t want to depend on platforms that can change their terms overnight or lock you out. With this stack, you own the codebase, the data, and the delivery mechanism. It’s pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are real challenges. If it works there, it works anywhere. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution for creators who want to build on their own terms.
Own your infrastructure—don’t rent it.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack has a specific role: 1. **GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages**: Hosts your storefront. Free and scalable. 2. **Cloudflare Workers/Google Apps Script**: Handles backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery. 3. **Supabase/Google Sheets**: Stores order data. Supabase is for advanced use cases; Google Sheets is simpler. 4. **Google Drive/Cloudflare R2**: Stores your ebook files securely. 5. **NOWPayments**: Verifies crypto payments on-chain and triggers delivery. Charges only 0.5% per transaction. 6. **Email Delivery**: Sends download links via SMTP or a transactional email service. These components integrate seamlessly. For example, when NOWPayments verifies a payment, it sends a webhook to Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which then retrieves the ebook from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sends the download link to the buyer. No manual steps. No delays.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The **Complete Builder Kit** ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. If you prefer to build from scratch, begin with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Set up NOWPayments to handle crypto payments—configure it to accept USDT on BSC for low fees. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to write the backend logic. Test the flow end-to-end: simulate a payment, verify the webhook triggers, and ensure the ebook is delivered. Once deployed, load your products and launch your store. The **Complete Builder Kit** includes step-by-step guides and source code to accelerate this process. You’ll have a fully operational store in 48 hours or less. No technical debt. No platform lock-in. Just sovereign infrastructure you own.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment works by verifying the payment on-chain using NOWPayments. Once verified, a webhook triggers backend logic (via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script) to send the ebook download link to the buyer. The process is instant, automatic, and requires no manual intervention. The buyer pays in crypto, and the system handles conversion to USD at transaction time. This eliminates the need for Stripe or PayPal, giving you full control over your commerce infrastructure.
Crypto payments verified on-chain in seconds.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy this stack today, the **Complete Builder Kit** ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and step-by-step guides. It’s the fastest way to launch a sovereign ecommerce store without building everything from scratch. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 3. Write backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Store ebook files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Test the entire flow: payment, verification, and delivery. 7. Load your products and launch your store. 8. Monitor transactions and optimize as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The **Complete Builder Kit** includes templates and blueprints that require minimal technical knowledge. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your store.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees (under $0.10).
Do I need to handle KYC for buyers?
No. NOWPayments does not require KYC for buyers, and they don’t need an account to pay. It’s a seamless experience for your customers.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system will not deliver the ebook until payment is verified on-chain. Buyers can retry the payment, and the system will process it automatically once confirmed.
Can I scale this stack for more products?
Yes. The architecture is modular and scalable. You can add more products, upgrade to Supabase for order storage, and optimize for higher traffic as your business grows.
Automated delivery means no manual work for you.
